summary.text: Stephanie Barnard is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 8-Position 1, which she has represented since January 9, 2023, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career experience includes working as head of government affairs for the Tri-City Regional Chamber of Commerce.

paragraphs.text: Barnard was born in Washington, where she lives.
She succeeded Brad Klippert (R) in the District 8-Position 1 seat.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Environment & Energy and Finance committees.
Barnard won the 2024 general election with 97.5% of the vote in a race with no listed opponent.
She advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary and appears on the November ballot without a listed opponent.
